name: Ikaseya Heiji ~Seikan Massa Jigoku~
original_name: イカセ屋平次～性姦マッサぢごく～
source:
Heiji is a massager and runs a small massage shop. However, he has a secret hobby.... That is to grope bodies of female customers. One day, two beautiful girls come to his shop. One is Kanan, a popular idol singer, and the other is Yukino, who lives nearby....

[From ErogeShop]
